facts.why: The plot gives July 16, 1969 as Boris's jump date and July 15 as the day J must stop him. J's own landing date is not stated in the sources opened.

vibe.verdict: Wu's, the Factory, Coney Island and Apollo 11 are the right places, and the pie cue is spot on, but the food is generic and the voice is shared.
missing: Pie don't work unless you let it (Young K at the diner)
Griffin's pastrami sandwich and his many futures (the Factory)
Whistlers Bar, warm beer and the worst food (K and O in London)
Jeffrey Price and the time machine (the shop)
ideas: Swap 'Sixties party walnut cheese ball' note for 'Griffin's pastrami, every possible future'
Swap 'Crab rangoon' note for 'Wu's fish, all opinions are his'
Swap 'Agency meatloaf' for 'Whistlers Bar, warm beer and worst food'
Swap the 'Time Jump Ticket' for 'Pie don't work unless you let it'
